{{dablink|For the thirteenth book of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series, see ''[[Towers of Midnight]]''. For other uses of the words "tower" and "night," see [[Tower]] and [[Night]].}}
'''The Towers of Midnight''' are a complex of thirteen fortresses built from unpolished black marble located within the city of [[Imfaral]] on the [[Seanchan]] continent.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Towers of Midnight}}  The Towers of Midnight are first noted in history as the place where [[Deain]], the creator of the ''[[a'dam]]'', was imprisoned after being betrayed by [[Luthair Paendrag Mondwin]] during [[The Conquest]].

The Towers of Midnight and the city of Imfaral were captured early during Luthair's invasion, and were the primary base of operations for the invaders before they took [[Seandar]] later in the war.

Since the [[Consolidation]], the Towers have remained unoccupied. Legend has it that when a time of dire need comes, the Imperial family will return to the Towers and "right that which is wrong".{{ref/book|13|Glossary}}

==Sources==
Robert Jordan expanded on the Towers of Midnight at [http://home.casema.nl/e.f.delaat/Dragon%20Con%20day%202.html DragonCon 2005].
